item.title: [15] Eagle: Construction of a new 429 SF attached garage addition to the existing single-family residence, with 752 SF of unfinished bonus space above the existing and new garages. Included in the plans is a 162 SF unfinished future loft extension to tie the existing loft area of the second story to the unfinished bonus room above the garage (and provide access to that area). No finished or conditioned living area is being added under this permit. Scope also includes 350 SF of new driveway to serve the new garage from Eagle Hills Way.
